name: scene3d_patch_shots
description: Rename, re-time or reorder Motion takes. duration sets how long the take runs (floored at its own content — use it to hold a take longer than its last keyframe); trimStart/trimEnd crop what plays; index moves it in the sequence. Keyframe edits belong to scene3d_patch_keyframes. @see guides_get('scene3d')

duration.description: Take length (s). Never shorter than its own keyframes/motion.

index.description: New position in the sequence (0-based, in the resulting order).

trimEnd.description: Stop at this second. 0 = play to the end.

trimStart.description: Skip the first N seconds on playback/export.
